user.title: Sign in to Panasonic
user.description:
Enter the credentials of your Panasonic Smart App (China) account.
The session is cached on first login; when it expires, reauthentication refreshes it without changing devices or entity IDs.

device.title: Select a device
device.description: Devices found. This integration supports only the CS-ZY35K410 (AirconCommon); choose the air conditioner to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Panasonic again
reauth_confirm.description:
The cloud session has expired (auth error 4102). Enter your credentials to refresh the SSID.
Note: Panasonic accounts allow a single session, so signing in here signs the phone app out. Device and entity IDs are unchanged.

error.cannot_connect: Login failed: check your credentials or network connection
error.token_generation_failed: Token generation failed: unexpected device ID format
error.no_devices_found: No devices found: make sure an air conditioner is bound to this account
error.all_devices_configured: All devices have already been added

abort.no_devices_found: No devices found: make sure a CS-ZY35K410 is bound to this account
abort.all_devices_configured: All devices have already been added
